steps.code:
st = primitives.call(name='observe_robocasa365_kitchen_state')
d = st.output
pveg = d['objects']['vegetable']['position']
pmeat = d['objects']['meat']['position']
print('veg', pveg)

gv3 = primitives.call(name='ground_robocasa365_visual_target', entity_name='vegetable', world_position=pveg)
print('gv3', gv3.ok)
vh = gv3.output['evidence_handle']

g = primitives.call(name='grasp_robocasa365_object', object_name='vegetable',
                    evidence_handles=[vh], gripper_command=1.0, horizon=25,
                    grasp_approach='center', grasp_wrist_yaw_offset_rad=0.0)
print('grasp', g.ok)
print(str(g.output)[:400])
ts = primitives.call(name='inspect_robocasa365_transport_state', object_name='vegetable')
print('ts', ts.ok, str(ts.output)[:400])

steps.title: robocasa365 kitchen state · ground robocasa365 visual target · move robocasa365 ee to
steps.code:
st = primitives.call(name='observe_robocasa365_kitchen_state')
p = st.output['objects']['vegetable']['position']
gv4 = primitives.call(name='ground_robocasa365_visual_target', entity_name='vegetable', world_position=p)
vh = gv4.output['evidence_handle'] if gv4.ok else None
print('vh', vh, p)

if vh is not None:
    mv = primitives.call(name='move_robocasa365_ee_to', target_name='vegetable',
                         evidence_handles=[vh], gripper_command=1.0,
                         horizon=20, offset=[0.0, 0.0, 0.06])
    print('mv', mv.ok)
    gv5 = primitives.call(name='ground_robocasa365_visual_target', entity_name='vegetable', world_position=p)
    vh2 = gv5.output['evidence_handle'] if gv5.ok else vh
    g = primitives.call(name='grasp_robocasa365_object', object_name='vegetable',
                        evidence_handles=[vh2], gripper_command=1.0, horizon=20,
                        grasp_approach='near_side', grasp_wrist_yaw_offset_rad=0.0,
                        offset=[0.0, 0.0, -0.02])
    print('g', g.ok, str(g.output)[:300])
    ts = primitives.call(name='inspect_robocasa365_transport_state', object_name='vegetable')
    print('ts', ts.ok, str(ts.output)[:400])
